entities.description: optional entity key per row (defaults to the row index); must match rows in length

rows.description: the batch to score: one object per entity mapping each input the model's feature_schema.inputs names to its value — a number or boolean for a numeric feature, the original text (or null) for a categorical one, which is one-hot encoded with the levels fitted at training time (an unseen level encodes as all zeros). Every input must be present; extra fields are ignored

top_k.description: cap the ranked at-risk list to the k highest-risk entities (absent = all rows)
